The target must be a prior distribution on the state space that is invariant under the Metropolis step (so detailed balance holds). For discrete, the condition is: For any transition from state i to j, the acceptance probability must satisfy: P(i->j) / P(i) = λ_{i->j} (target probability) / P_{target}(j). If target probability is constant, we can compute acceptance probability.
